passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations should be read together with our consolidated financial statements and related notes, and other financial information, included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. In addition to our historical results of operations and financial position, this discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results could differ materially from those discussed in or implied by these forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause or contribute to such differences include, but are not limited to, those discussed in the section titled "Risk Factors." Our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results to be expected for any period in the future, and results for any interim period should not be construed as an inference of what our results would be for any full year or future period. Overview CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI purpose-built to accelerate breakthroughs by AI pioneers, from leading research labs to enterprises fueling business growth. We deliver a comprehensive, tightly integrated platform of advanced infrastructure and proprietary software that enables our customers to build and run AI systems continuously, reliably, and at scale. CoreWeave is trusted by some of the world's leading AI labs and enterprises. Our CoreWeave Cloud Platform includes: • Networking Backbone. Our network backbone supports the bandwidth and connectivity that our customers need to move large-scale distributed AI workloads. • Foundational Infrastructure. Our purpose-built foundational infrastructure maximizes performance with first-to-market GPU clusters, ultra-high density, and high-speed interconnects, supporting complex AI workloads while improving efficiency and lowering total cost of ownership. • Data and Storage. CoreWeave's purpose-built storage combines exascale, AI-optimized object and file storage with GPU-local caching and Local Tier Acceleration (LOTA™) to deliver high-throughput data access, cross-cloud reach, and predictable economics for training and inference. • Infrastructure Control. Our integrated AI-native orchestration and bare-metal control deliver the reliability, flexibility, and efficiency required to run complex AI workloads at scale, and matched with the right AI services. • CoreWeave Mission Control. CoreWeave Mission Control integrates security, observability, and services—including node, rack, and fleet lifecycle management—to enable intelligent, unified orchestration from foundational infrastructure to agent development. • Runtime Acceleration. CoreWeave delivers platform services that accelerate training and inference by reducing startup latency, improving throughput, and increasing utilization at runtime—removing friction across scheduling, environment readiness, and execution so jobs reach steady-state performance faster and run more efficiently at scale. • Model and Agent Development. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: A description of the risks and uncertainties associated with our business is set forth below. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently believe are not material, may also become important factors that adversely affect our business. If any of the following risks occur, our business, operating results, financial condition, and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the trading price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you could lose all or a part of your investment. Summary Risk Factors Our business is subject to numerous risks and uncertainties and this summary provides an overview of such risks. You should read this risk factor summary together with the more detailed discussion of risks and uncertainties following this summary. • Our business would be harmed if we were not able to access sufficient power or by increased costs to procure power, prolonged power outages, shortages, or capacity constraints. • We have a limited number of suppliers for significant components of the equipment we use to build and operate our platform and provide our solutions and services. Any disruption in the availability of these components could delay our ability to expand or increase the capacity of our infrastructure or replace defective equipment. • If our data center providers fail to meet the requirements of our business, or if the data center facilities experience damage, interruption, or a security breach, our ability to provide access to our infrastructure and maintain the performance of our network could be negatively impacted. • Our recent growth may not be indicative of our future growth, and if we do not effectively manage our future growth, our business, operating results, financial condition, and prospects may be adversely affected. • A substantial portion of our revenue is driven by a limited number of our customers, and the loss of, or a significant reduction in, spending from one or a few of our top customers would adversely affect our business, operating results, financial condition, and prospects. • Our operations require substantial and growing capital expenditures, and we will require additional capital to fund our business and support our growth, and any inability to generate or obtain such capital on acceptable terms, if at all, or to lower our total cost of capital, may adversely affect our business, operating results, financial condition, and prospects. • If we fail to efficiently enhance our platform and develop and sell new solutions and services and respond effectively to rapidly changing technology, evolving industry standards, changing regulations, and changing customer needs, requirements, or preferences, our platform may become less competitive. • The broader adoption, use, and commercialization of artificial intelligence ("AI") technology, and the continued rapid pace of developments in the AI field, are inherently uncertain. Failure

credit_strengths.text: CoreWeave's AI cloud platform generates substantial revenue and positive operating cash flow, reflecting strong demand from leading AI labs and enterprises. The business benefits from long-term customer contracts and a differentiated GPU-optimized infrastructure, which supports recurring cash generation despite heavy investment. This cash flow provides a foundation for servicing debt, though its sufficiency relative to the capital-intensive model remains a key monitorable.

The company maintains a sizable cash balance, which offers some liquidity buffer against near-term obligations. However, the cash position is modest relative to the debt load and the massive capital expenditure program. The cash balance partially offsets debt in net leverage calculations, but the overall liquidity profile is tight given the current ratio below one and significant maturities ahead.

key_risks.text: CoreWeave's operations require substantial and growing capital expenditures, and the company will need additional capital to fund growth. The risk factor explicitly states that inability to obtain such capital on acceptable terms could adversely affect the business. This is a concrete risk given the negative free cash flow and the need to refinance or raise new debt to sustain the buildout.

A substantial portion of revenue is driven by a limited number of customers, and the loss of or significant reduction in spending from top customers would adversely affect results. This concentration risk is compounded by the capital-intensive nature of the business, where fixed costs and debt service obligations remain regardless of customer demand fluctuations. Such dependency heightens cash flow volatility and refinancing risk.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is deeply negative, with operating income insufficient to cover even a fraction of interest expense. The company relies on operating cash flow, which is positive but far below the level needed to comfortably service debt. With gross leverage above eight times and net leverage near seven and a half times, debt servicing capacity is highly strained and dependent on continued revenue growth and margin improvement.

The debt maturity profile is front-loaded, with a significant portion due within the next twelve months. This creates substantial refinancing risk, especially given the negative free cash flow and the need to fund ongoing capital expenditures. The company's ability to roll over or repay these obligations will depend on capital markets access and continued lender support, which are not assured.

overall_credit_view.text: CoreWeave presents a highly leveraged credit profile, with debt levels far exceeding sector medians and an indicative financial risk profile of 'Highly leveraged'. The combination of negative operating income, massive capital expenditures, and negative free cash flow results in a weak capacity to service debt from internal resources. The company's credit quality is heavily reliant on external financing and continued rapid growth.

Our forward-looking view is cautious. While revenue growth and positive operating cash flow are strengths, the capital intensity and customer concentration pose significant risks. The company must manage its maturity profile and secure additional funding to sustain operations. Without a substantial improvement in profitability and cash flow generation, the credit profile is likely to remain under pressure, with limited headroom for adverse developments.

credit_strengths.text: CoreWeave 的人工智能雲端平台產生可觀收入及正數營運現金流，反映來自領先人工智能實驗室及企業的強勁需求。該業務受惠於長期客戶合約及差異化的 GPU 優化基礎設施，儘管投資龐大，仍支持經常性現金產生。此現金流為償付債務提供基礎，但相對於資本密集型模式而言，其充足性仍是關鍵監察點。
該公司維持可觀的現金結餘，為短期債務提供若干流動性緩衝。然而，現金狀況相對於債務負擔及龐大資本開支計劃而言僅屬溫和。現金結餘在淨槓桿計算中部分抵銷債務，但鑑於流動比率低於一及未來有大量到期債務，整體流動性狀況緊張。

key_risks.text: CoreWeave 的營運需要龐大且不斷增長的資本開支，公司將需要額外資本以資助增長。風險因素明確指出，若無法按可接受條款取得有關資本，可能對業務造成不利影響。鑑於自由現金流為負，以及需要再融資或籌集新債務以維持建設，此乃具體風險。
相當部分收入由有限數目客戶帶動，失去主要客戶或其主要客戶大幅削減開支將對業績造成不利影響。此集中度風險因業務的資本密集型性質而加劇，當中固定成本及償債責任不論客戶需求波動仍會存在。此依賴性提高現金流波動性及再融資風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率嚴重為負，營運收入不足以覆蓋利息開支的哪怕一小部分。公司依賴營運現金流，其雖為正數，但遠低於從容償付債務所需的水平。總槓桿高於八倍，淨槓桿接近七倍半，償債能力高度緊張，並依賴收入持續增長及利潤率改善。
債務到期結構前置，相當部分將於未來十二個月內到期。此構成重大再融資風險，尤其鑑於自由現金流為負及需要為持續資本開支提供資金。公司滾動續期或償還該等債務的能力將取決於資本市場准入及貸款人持續支持，而該等支持並非必然。

overall_credit_view.text: CoreWeave 呈現高度槓桿的信用狀況，債務水平遠超行業中位數，指示性財務風險狀況為「高度槓桿」。營運收入為負、龐大資本開支及自由現金流為負的組合，導致以內部資源償付債務的能力疲弱。公司的信用質素嚴重依賴外部融資及持續快速增長。
我們的前瞻性觀點審慎。儘管收入增長及正數營運現金流為優勢，資本密集度及客戶集中度構成重大風險。公司必須管理其到期結構並確保額外資金以維持營運。若盈利能力及現金流產生未有大幅改善，信用狀況可能持續受壓，應對不利發展的緩衝空間有限。
